**PR-1 = GitHub #240** (branch `feat/issue-239-a3-pr1`) — OPEN, awaiting human review/merge.
- Delivered: Phase 1 (`labelEvents` both providers) + R3 gap fix (`defaultFetchIssue`→issueView) + 4th-site fix (`defaultFetchReviews`→new `prReviews` verb) + `issueView` author + generalized anti-spawn guard. Class of "CI fetch ignores runtime provider" (4 sites) CLOSED by audit. See [[sdd/issue-239-a3/r3-gap-ruling]].
- Evidence: 1169/1169 tests, 395/400 non-test budget, 2 clean fresh reviews.
- 4 work-unit commits (feat verbs / refactor checks / guard test / docs). Strays `.memory/chunks/` + `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md` deliberately excluded (see [[memory/orphaned-chunks-post-c4]]).

**NEXT (after #240 merges)**: PR-2 = Phase 2 (GitLab `prView`/`mrCreate` un-stub over `gitlabApiFetch`, tasks 2.1-2.6) off updated `feature/v2.0.0`. Then PR-3 = Phases 3-4 (shared contract suite + recorded fixtures) — CP-A3a verdict tranche.

**Standing workflow**: push+PR without asking; only merge is human-gated ([[workflow/push-pr-authorization]]).
